snapshot.h2: How we work with restaurants in Doral
paragraphsHtml: Our crew comes to your restaurant in Doral to film. One shoot typically produces 4 to 6 weeks of content. From there we post it and manage your pages, and we can take on your website, your Google profile and your ads too.

The Fatty Crab, a Cajun seafood boil restaurant at 2000 NW 87th Ave, is our client in Doral. We moved its feed from mostly static posts to short video, built every post around the food, the experience, the people or the culture, and post when its followers are online.

proof.h2: Social media for The Fatty Crab in Doral
proof.statLabel: video views on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok
proof.bodyHtml: We run The Fatty Crab's social media on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. Eleven of its Instagram Reels have passed 1 million views. From July 2023 to March 2024 we also teamed up with a local food creator, which brought in a wave of new followers.

steps.h2: How we'd start with your Doral restaurant

items.title: A free call with Juan
items.bodyHtml: In 30 minutes, Juan, our co-founder, goes through your Google Business Profile, website and social pages with you and tells you what he would focus on first.

items.title: A shoot day at your restaurant
items.bodyHtml: Our crew films at your restaurant on a day that works for you, and we edit the footage into Reels, TikToks and photos with captions in English, Spanish or both.

items.title: Posting, Google updates and a monthly report
items.bodyHtml: We post the content and manage your pages, keep your Google Business Profile current through our restaurant SEO and AEO service, and send you a monthly report.

pricingHtml: Most restaurants invest $1,500 to $5,000 a month for a coordinated program. Website builds are a one-time $1,500 or $2,000.

faqs.q: Do you work with restaurants in Doral?
faqs.a: Yes. We're headquartered in Miami, and our crew works with Doral restaurants in person. One of our clients, The Fatty Crab, is at 2000 NW 87th Ave.

faqs.q: Will your team come to my restaurant to film?
faqs.a: Yes. We film at your restaurant on a day that works for you. One shoot typically produces 4 to 6 weeks of content.

faqs.q: Can social media bring in delivery orders?
faqs.a: It can. For The Fatty Crab, one organic Reel with pack-out shots and an "Order on Uber Eats" call to action, posted at peak delivery hours, drove Uber Eats orders without paying for ads.

faqs.q: Do you create content in Spanish?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team works in English and Spanish, so captions and posts can be in either language or both. Every website page we build comes in both languages.

cta.h2: Let's talk about your Doral restaurant
cta.body: Book a free 30-minute call with Juan. He'll look at how your restaurant shows up online today and tell you where he would start. The call can be in English or Spanish.
